evidence: You can walk the Round the Mountain Track in either direction; here we describe it going clockwise.
The track begins along Ngauruhoe Place, 100 m below Whakapapa Visitor Centre.
From here the track undulates for a number of easy climbs and descents before joining the well formed Silica Rapids Track, for the last 45 min to Whakapapa Village.

evidence: The track entrance is just above Whakapapa Holiday Park, and is also the track entrance for the Silica Rapids / Whakapapaiti Valley Track. The walk to Whakapapaiti Hut is 2 hr 30 min.

doubts: Start ref F2 is one of two road-end features (F2, F3) named 'Taranaki Falls Track meets NGAURUHOE TERRACE'; the text says Ngauruhoe Place. The loop actually finishes on the Silica Rapids Track near the village, end set to the same place as start. F6/F7 assigned by order up Ohakune Mountain Road (11-12 km and 15 km, F7 further north). Extra loop ways W2-W6 are the page's access locations ('You can access the Round the Mountain Track from several locations'); their via lists follow the round-the-mountain order and are not stated by the page in detail; W4 Desert Road direction not stated. W7/W8 are the page's example part-track options; end point on Ohakune Mountain Road not specified. Tukino Road is not a regular access point. Waihohonu Hut assumed to be the new hut.
